"""Exercise real report reservation and delivery with a local fake API."""
import json
import os
import pathlib
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from unittest.mock import Mock
from test_app import APP, config
from writer_fence import writer_lease

p = pathlib.Path('/data/qa.sqlite3')
stage = os.environ['QA_STAGE']
mode = os.environ['SCHEDULED_REPORTS_MODE']

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def do_POST(self):
        payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers['Content-Length'])))
        with open('/data/accepted', 'a') as f:
            f.write(payload['text'] + '\n')
        body = json.dumps({'ok': True, 'result': {'message_id': 42}}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 18766), Handler)
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
m = APP.Monitor(config(database_path=p, poll_interval=.1,
    telegram_token='qa-fake', telegram_chat_id='qa-fake',
    telegram_admin_user_ids=('7',), scheduled_reports_mode=mode,
    shelly_meter_type='pro3em', offline_after_failures=10000, health_port=8080))
m.initialize = Mock()
m.command_loop = Mock()
m.update_status = Mock()
m.run_periodic_tasks = Mock()
m.daily_summary_enabled = False
m.shelly.read_phases = lambda: {'L1': (219.,50.,1.), 'L2': (220.,50.,1.), 'L3': (221.,50.,1.)}
m.telegram.base = 'http://127.0.0.1:18766'
APP.install_signals()
def deliver(key, period, text):
    return m.deliver_scheduled_report(key, period, text, 'qa-fake')

with writer_lease(p):
    m.storage.initialize()
    if stage == 'initial':
        assert deliver('daily_summary_day', '2026-11-27', 'initial-report')
        assert m.storage.reserve_report('telegram_weekly_private_sent_7', '2026-W48')
    else:
        assert not deliver('daily_summary_day', '2026-11-27', 'duplicate-daily')
        assert not deliver('telegram_weekly_private_sent_7', '2026-W48', 'duplicate-pending')
        if stage == 'paused':
            assert not deliver('telegram_weekly_private_sent_8', '2026-W48', 'paused-report')
        else:
            assert deliver('telegram_weekly_private_sent_8', '2026-W48', 'resumed-report')
    m.telegram.send('ordinary-' + stage)
    APP.start_health_server(m)
    m.run()
pathlib.Path('/data/graceful-' + stage).write_text('1')
